from alvo import compact

def test_validate_errors():
    # Wrong length should raise InvalidLength
    with pytest.raises(InvalidLength):
        validate('1234567890')          # 10 digits

    # Incorrect checksum should raise InvalidChecksum
    with pytest.raises(InvalidChecksum):
        validate('39053344706')         # last digit altered

    # Non‑digit characters should raise InvalidFormat
    with pytest.raises(InvalidFormat):
        validate('abcd')                # letters only
